title: Quantum computers outperform classical ones, with results you can trust
summary: Further, in the absence of a mathematical proof of the capabilities of quantum hardware, it’s possible that a better classical algorithm could outperform the quantum hardware. A set of gates first alters a quantum system, after which the process is reversed.
